Cartography in a plain page

Each drawing below is a YAML file next to this page, drawn in your browser. Hold Ctrl (or pinch) to zoom, drag to move, double-click to zoom in and out again.

A file, with drill-down

Click Web shop to open its containers; from there the Orders API leads to its deployment. Backspace goes back.

Views of one file

controls="views" adds a view picker.

YAML in the page

No file to fetch: the diagram is written inside the element.

Always dark

theme="dark" keeps a diagram dark whatever the page does; without it the diagram follows the page.

When something is wrong

A problem is shown where the diagram would be, with the line it is on.

Scroll down: the last diagram is drawn only when it comes near.

Drawn when it scrolls into view
